# .github/leak-waivers.txt - TRACKED waivers for GENERIC pattern hits only.
# RULE: a waiver line must NEVER contain a private value (name, handle, host,
# id). Private waivers belong in .github/release-waivers.txt (gitignored).
# Format: path:key # reason   (key = pattern text from the patterns file)
# Every applied waiver is printed by scripts/leak_gate.sh on every run.
